title: lore-cli worker handoff, 2026-11-22: 0.15.1 released, follow-ups, ubuntu push-run red to settle
description: Handoff from the lore-cli worker session that cut 0.15.1 (renewal at the context budget, DEC-158). The live tracker and repository outrank this; verify before acting. STATE (read 2026-11-22 ~09:20Z): dev 36db999e, one commit ahead of main c57a9a88 (that commit is the CLAUDE.md profile fix, #769, LCLI-820, closed). v0.15.1 (tag object 0316a1c4, peels to 9c6b3932) stands. 0.15.1 is RELEASED and live on latest (lore and quest), GitHub Release published, opum-marketplace landed its pin bump (opum-ai/opum-marketplace#260). Closed this session: LCLI-804 (release), LCLI-819 (cli-contract 4.2, DEC-282 a17), LCLI-820 (profile marketplace pin). IN FLIGHT: (1) CI push run 45005825388 on main landing SHA c57a9a88: required job lint-typecheck-test (ubuntu-latest) failed in its Test step (job 137157072346); I could not read the log while the run was in progress. The diff since v0.15.1 is docs and .quest only, so it is most likely the ubuntu runner-stall/timeout class, but that is a hypothesis: read the log, settle with the reachability control (the same tree passed ubuntu on #767 head 58d7ab4c), do not retry blindly; team-lead has been told. The Main fast-forward guard on that SHA is green; the pull_request run is red only on promotion is manual, by design. (2) The CLAUDE.md profile fix is on dev but not yet on main; it rides the next promotion (no rush). OPEN ITEMS, not started: LCLI-786 (publish-release.sh install smoke ETARGET; held, did NOT fire at the 0.15.1 staging, smoke printed 0.15.1), LCLI-811 and LCLI-812 (alias handling follow-ups labelled post-0.15.1), LCLI-805 (upstream-backlog-watch), LCLI-781 and LCLI-782 (held). SEVEN tasks sit In Progress and some are stale (LCLI-751, 760, 768, 771, 775, 791, 797); groom them before relying on the In Progress list or the flush hook, which writes no note while more than one is In Progress. Do not edit the tag, publish, or run publish-release.sh or promote-latest.mjs without the leader and the operator. SKILLS to reach for: opum-workflow:opum-sdlc (branch/PR/promotion), opum-workflow:opum-handoff, lore. METHOD NOTES learned this session, all measured: wait for check runs with total>=14 AND zero non-completed, read from one array (an earlier loop broke early on a racy read); shell-built paths and composed pushes are refused by the guards, so push bare and use literal paths; a stale baseline quoted from CLAUDE.md misled opum-marketplace, so read pins by ref (LCLI-820).

implementationNotes: CI push run 45005825388 on main landing SHA c57a9a88: re-run green; root cause the known bun epoll race, not fixed. Attempt 1 failed only in lint-typecheck-test (ubuntu-latest), Test step (job 137157072346), with 17 occurrences of "error: EEXIST: file already exists, epoll_ctl" and failing tests in the A1 packed-artifact group that the docs- and .quest-only diff since v0.15.1 cannot reach; the same tree was green on #767 head 58d7ab4c. One re-run of the failed job (attempt 2, authorised by team-lead, run once) concluded success, with no job failed. The re-run is not the evidence; the signature, the unreachable tests and the green PR run are. Acceptance criterion 1 is answered in substance, though the failing tests are named only as the A1 group seen in the log, not enumerated, and the epoll race itself remains unfixed.

FROM opum-cli-e2e (relayed by team-lead 2026-11-22, not yet diagnosed or read by me): opum-ai/opum-cli-e2e run 45006664322 (arm64, job "qualification matrix vs the committed baseline"), row "lore/workspace :: every workspace-capable read succeeds against the projection" failed with "lore query --workspace exits 0: exit -1" (child killed or timed out) against registry lore 0.15.1, while graph, context, impact and path exited 0. It passed on other runs of the same pin, and the run was cancelled before any re-run finished.
